lines.text: Many learners say: You have a pen?
Better: Do you have a pen?
Do! Do you have a pen?

native.tip: Kita sering bertanya hanya dengan nada naik: “Kamu punya pulpen?” Di bahasa Inggris, pertanyaan perlu do di depan.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “You have a pen?” 😅 Mulai pertanyaan dengan do: “Do you have a pen?” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “Do”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “Do you have a pen?” lalu tulis satu pertanyaan dengan Do you. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We often ask with rising tone only: “Kamu punya pulpen?” English questions need do at the start.
en.caption: Ever say this? “You have a pen?” 😅 Start the question with do: “Do you have a pen?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
